4823-5929-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
4823-5929-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Leyline of Transformation, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Timeless Witness token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

745-2896-3518-5131.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard using Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Mirrorhall Mimic by paying {3}{U}, causing it to enter with an additional Spirit type as a copy of Muldrotha.
Put the original Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard using the new Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Necromancy by paying {2}{B}.
When Necromancy enters, it triggers, becoming an Aura and returning Muldrotha from the graveyard to the battlefield with Necromancy attached to it.
Put the copy of Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat.

2638-3000-3510-5929.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Leyline of Transformation.
2638-3000-3510-5929.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each creature or land that entered is a Saproling through Leyline of Transformation and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Tireless Tracker to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Tireless Tracker trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Chatterfang.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

1283-1651-3129-7824-8276.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate The Hive by paying {5} and tapping it, creating four 1/1 Wasp artifact creature tokens due to Primal Vigor and Bard.
Activate Clock of Omens twice by tapping the Wasps, untapping Chromatic Orrery and The Hive.
Repeat.
1283-1651-3129-7824-8276.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards.

2438-4452-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
2438-4452-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Repeat from step 3.

7299-8185.description:
Cast Rout by paying its mana cost, destroying all creatures.
Cast Biorhythm by paying its mana cost, causing each player's life total to become equal to the number of creatures they control.
Each player that controls no creatures loses the game due to having 0 life.
7299-8185.notes: You will also lose the game if you control no creatures as Biorhythm resolves, causing the game to end in a draw. You can avoid this by putting a creature onto the battlefield after step 1, or by having an indestructible creature. Similarly, any opponent who controls an indestructible creature will not have 0 life or lose the game.

3234-3293-5411-6495.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-5411-6495.description:
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat
3234-3293-5411-6495.notes:
You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.
If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1308-4365-4826-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1594-3532-5078-7811.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Iron Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2781-6626-6867-7055.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

876-3814-7070.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two mana-producing lands.
876-3814-7070.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Argothian Elder.
Monk Gyatso triggers. Choose not to airbend Argothian Elder.
Resolve Lightning Greaves' ability, attaching it to Argothian Elder.
Activate two mana-producing lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Argothian Elder by tapping it, untapping the lands.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Monk Gyatso.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Argothian Elder.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Argothian Elder.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Argothian Elder from exile by paying {2}.
Repeat.

2292-5961--5.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Uncivil Unrest
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat

2054-7420-7546.description:
Cast a copy of Maestro's Gift from exile by paying {3}{U}{R}.
When you cast that spell, Molten-Core Maestro triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself and adding an amount of {R} equal to its power.
Maestro's Gift resolves, creating a copy of Inspired Skypainter who enters prepared and with haste.
If needed, activate Urn of Godfire by paying {R}{R}, adding {U}
Repeat, adding an ever-increasing amount of {R} in step 2.

4659-5086-5183-6705-6996.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
4659-5086-5183-6705-6996.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

240-4359-5470-5686.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token
Repeat from step 2.

1846-3191-4276-5134.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three Islands
1846-3191-4276-5134.description:
Cast High Tide by paying {U}.
Cast Fated Infatuation by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Kairi.
Put the Kairi token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Kairi token dies, it triggers, causing you to mill six cards and return High Tide and Fated Infatuation from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast High Tide by paying {U}.
Activate at least three Islands by tapping them, adding {U}{U}{U}.
High Tide triggers twice for each Island tapped this way, adding that much {U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Fated Infatuation by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Kairi.
Put the Kairi token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Kairi token dies, it triggers, causing you to mill six cards and return Turnabout and Fated Infatuation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 6.

147-3967-6817.description:
Cast Presumed Dead by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Presumed Dead, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Presumed Dead.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Yahenni abilities from step 5.

1778-4659-5220-6900.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Memnite
When Memnite dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Memnite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Memnite from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

2292-4375-5361.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Auton Soldier enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Auton Soldier.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

2425-6249-6798--5.easyPrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2425-6249-6798--5.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Smothering Abomination trigger.
Resolve the Smothering Abomination trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

5299-5921-5970-6633--112.notablePrerequisites:
Mirror Room is locked.
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
5299-5921-5970-6633--112.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a token copy of Marina.
Put the tapped Marina into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Marina token enters the battlefield, it's first ability triggers twice, causing you to look at the top seven cards of your library and put all enchantment cards from among them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library, and then repeat this once.
Resolve the second Mirror Room trigger, creating a token copy of itself, as it is a creature due to Opalescence.
Activate the Marina token by tapping it, unlocking the token Mirror Room.
Repeat from step 2.
5299-5921-5970-6633--112.notes: The chosen anthem must increase the toughness of the Mirror Room token so it does not die as it enters the battlefield.

856-2279-2829-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Quintorius trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.

1429-4452-5256-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-4452-5256-5402.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

147-167-5231.description:
Cost Not Dead After All by paying {B}, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Not Dead After All, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Not Dead After All.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, adding {R}.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a Wicked Role token attached to it.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Not Dead After All, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Not Dead After All.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, adding {R}.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it and the Wicked Role token attached to it trigger.
Resolve the Wicked Role trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a Wicked Role token attached to it.
Repeat from step 7.

1170-1645-2792.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {R}{R}.
1170-1645-2792.description:
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {R}{R}.
Cast Crown of Flames by paying its mana cost, targeting Displacer Kitten
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Great Whale.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the Crown of Flames spell.
Activate Crown of Flames by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1115-1445-5477.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one creature card in your hand.
You have at least one creature card in your graveyard.
1115-1445-5477.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning any other creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token, then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Activate the Plant by tapping it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

4499-4605-4716-5542.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Prosperous Innkeeper.
When Prosperous Innkeeper enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, and Preston trigger twice if it has power 2 or less, or once otherwise.
Resolve both Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the first Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Prosperous Innkeeper that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Prosperous Innkeeper token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 4 for the remaining Preston trigger, if applicable.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

369-2292-2730.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Iridescent Drake.
When Iridescent Drake dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Iridescent Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Iridescent Drake enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Iridescent Drake
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1987-2128-2493.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature, or land that can produce at least {U} the turn it enters the battlefield.
1987-2128-2493.description:
Activate a permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U} due to Hinata, blinking Archaeomancer and the permanent tapped for mana in step 1.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1561-3373.description:
Cast Peer into the Abyss by paying {4}{B}{B}{B}, causing target opponent to draw cards equal to half their library size and lose half their life total, rounding up each time.
At the beginning of your end step, Astarion triggers, causing the opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

3263-3764-5256.description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Pincher creature token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Pincher.
Summoning Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia trigger, causing target player to mill cards equal to the Pincher's power.
Repeat.
